name: Directus
description: Directus wraps any SQL database in a real-time REST and GraphQL API with an admin app on top. It is a headless CMS that never locks you in: your data stays in your database, and the platform is a layer, not a cage. Great for content teams and developers alike.
highlights: REST and GraphQL APIs generated from your schema
Admin app with roles, workflows, and translations
Works with existing SQL databases, no migration lock-in
Extensible with custom endpoints and hooks
curatorNote: Directus treats your database as the source of truth, which is the right call. The API-first approach makes it a quiet powerhouse for product teams.
